migrate(uint8,uint256).details: Explicit owner action can seed an APR-unready child; this is the      intentional manual exception to AUTOMATIC APR allocation rules.      New Convex exposure still obeys the 0.969 price floor and destination      cap. The operation reverts atomically if the exact exit cannot clear.

params.fromStrategyIndex: 0 = BoostHub -> Convex (sourceUnits are staked        sdFXN base units); 1 = Convex -> BoostHub (sourceUnits are staked        Curve LP / gauge units). Both are 18-decimal raw integers.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

rebalanceAllocations().details: Does not relocate existing positions, and observes current APR and caps.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAllocationCaps(uint16,uint16).details: Each <= 100%; both must total >= 100% so ordinary deposits can      have room in at least one child. This setter does not force an unwind      of existing holdings that may already exceed their new cap.

setConvexCurveLiquidityGuard(address).details: Requires the master owner's authority; no constructor-time guard dependency.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

migrate(uint8,uint256).notice: Owner-directed migration from one child into the other.

rebalanceAllocations().notice: Permissionless investment of previously idle, unlocked sdFXN.

setAllocationCaps(uint16,uint16).notice: Caps are percentages of gross vault assets (basis points).

setConvexCurveLiquidityGuard(address).notice: Configure or disable the external oracle guard after child deployment.
